title: Part History records Tracking turned off and Tracking turned on
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TRKHIST-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A} with nothing on hand: its only bin, {Bin-A}, holds 0.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click the clock icon (tooltip "Part History") on the {Part-A} row.
  5. Read the newest entry at the top of Part History.
  6. Go back to Parts → Inventory, search {Part-A} and click its row.
  7. Click the switch so it is on.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Open Part History for {Part-A} again and read the two newest entries.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The newest entry's Event reads "Tracking turned off", with your own name under Staff and today's date and time, even though the part holds nothing.
  • Step 9: The newest entry reads "Tracking turned on" and the one below it "Tracking turned off", each with your name, today's date and its own time.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-R11, with the entry text from S10-R22, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.5 (Part History) and tracking-note-4, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R11: “The change is recorded in Part History (S10-R22).”
  • S10-R22: “Turning tracking off writes the entry "Tracking turned off" to the part's Part History, and turning it on writes "Tracking turned on". A part with nothing on hand still gets the entry.”
